title: WorkBuddy Major Update: 'Human-Machine Dual Writing' Launches, the Office of the AI Era Has Arrived!
excerpt: On July 30, Tencent WorkBuddy released a major version update (V5.3.5): in collaboration with Tencent Docs, it officially launched the "human-AI dual-writing" c
content_html:
On July 30, Tencent WorkBuddy released a major version update (V5.3.5): in collaboration with Tencent Docs, it officially launched the "human-AI dual-writing" collaborative editing capability for the Agent era. The new version allows users to directly collaborate with AI within the same file when opening Word, Excel, PPT, Markdown, and other document formats, addressing pain points such as multi-role collaboration in "human-AI hybrid writing" teams.

From the traditional "human-file interaction" of conventional Office, to "human-human collaboration" in online documents, to "human-AI task completion" in the AI era, the launch of this feature in WorkBuddy has made AI the first time an "add-on" in office collaboration become a collaborator within the same document. It also achieved, for the first time in the industry, "human-human, human-AI, AI-AI" multi-end synchronized collaboration, driving Office into an AI-native collaboration era.

AI Enters Documents: From "Help You Write" to "Write with You"

Previously, users needed to switch between chat windows and Office software when using AI for work. To get AI to generate content, they had to copy and paste it into the document; to ask AI to modify existing materials, they had to re-describe the background and revise the entire text; when working in teams, it was difficult to collaborate in real-time around the same document with the same AI partner. Although AI could generate content, it was hard to truly integrate into the user's ongoing workflow.

With this upgrade, WorkBuddy now directly integrates AI capabilities into the document editing environment. After opening a Tencent Docs or local Office file in WorkBuddy, users can select text, table areas, or PPT pages in the original file and use natural language to tell AI what task needs to be completed. For example, selecting a market analysis report to optimize its expression; circling a set of Excel data to have AI analyze it and generate charts; specifying a PPT page to have AI adjust its structure and content; marking blank areas in a report to have AI add relevant sections.

AI-generated content appears directly in the original file, where users can continue to edit or add comments. AI will perceive and complete the modifications in real time. After AI completes the edits, users can take over and continue writing at any time. This means that AI is no longer just a "side panel assistant," but becomes a true collaborator in the creation process.

Three Core Upgrades Make AI Transition from "Auxiliary Add-on" to "Third Colleague"

The core of this upgrade is to give AI more document operation capabilities and context awareness similar to real collaborators, which are mainly reflected in three aspects:

First, it covers more files and scenarios, supporting full human-AI co-writing. Relying on Tencent Docs' editing capabilities, the latest version of WorkBuddy supports mainstream office formats such as Markdown, Word, Excel, and PPT, and covers both local Office files and online Tencent Docs. Whether it is a thesis, proposal, lesson plan, technical documentation, consulting report, or operational weekly reports, pitch materials, and data analysis, users can complete creation, editing, and collaboration in the same workflow.

Second, selecting and modifying is precise and efficient. Users can select paragraphs, data areas, or PPT canvases and let AI make changes only within the specified range, keeping the rest of the layout and content unchanged. For example, in Excel, you can circle thousands of rows of data and let AI perform a pivot analysis, generate trend charts, or batch correct errors and apply complex formulas. Switching to PPT, you can let AI automatically layout the analysis conclusions and charts in a blank area. For structured documents like proposals and lesson plans, you can select the areas to be filled and let AI complete them according to the template.

Third, multiple people plus AI, real-time collaboration without interruption. AI-generated content can be uploaded to Tencent Docs with one click, allowing team members to jointly edit the same document across different terminals, as well as collaborate with the same AI partner. All changes are synchronized in real time, and the document context remains intact. From personal writing to team collaboration, to multiple people working on the same task with AI together, human collaboration, human-AI collaboration, and AI-AI collaboration are seamlessly integrated within the same document.

From the first generation solving individual local office work, to the second generation solving multi-person collaboration through online documents, as AI agents are deeply integrated into enterprise productivity, office software is moving towards the third stage. By enabling "human-human, human-AI, AI-AI" collaboration, WorkBuddy is transforming Office from a simple tool into an AI-native office system that understands tasks, understands context, collaborates in editing, and continuously manages business operations.

Currently, WorkBuddy has become one of the most popular efficiency AI tools in China by DAU, and has achieved comprehensive coverage of mainstream operating systems such as Win, Mac, HarmonyOS, and Android. Based on this foundation, WorkBuddy deeply integrates with ecosystem products such as Tencent Docs, Tencent ima, Tencent Meeting, Tencent Cloud Drive, TAPD, and Tencent LeXiang, and fully connects the content creation, knowledge accumulation, and capability reuse chain through One ID.

content_html_zh:
7月30日，腾讯WorkBuddy发布重大版本更新（V5.3.5）：联合腾讯文档，正式推出Agent时代的“人机双写”协同编辑能力。 新版本允许用户在打开Word、Excel、PPT、Markdown等文档格式时，在同一个文件中直接与AI协作，解决“人机混合写作”团队多角色协作等痛点。

从传统Office的“人与文件交互”，到在线文档的“人与人协作”，再到AI时代的“人与AI完成任务”，WorkBuddy这一功能的推出，让AI第一次成为办公协作中的“附加组件”，成为同一个文档中的协作者。 并在业界首次实现“人与人、人与AI、AI-AI”多端同步协作，推动Office进入AI原生协作时代。

AI走进文档：从“帮你写”到“陪你写”

此前，用户使用AI进行工作时，需要在聊天窗口和Office软件之间切换。 为了让人工智能生成内容，他们必须将其复制并粘贴到文档中；要要求AI修改现有材料，他们必须重新描述背景并修改整个文本；在团队中工作时，很难与同一个人工智能合作伙伴围绕同一个文档进行实时协作。 虽然人工智能可以生成内容，但很难真正融入到用户正在进行的工作流程中。

通过此次升级，WorkBuddy 现在直接将 AI 功能集成到文档编辑环境中。 用户在WorkBuddy中打开腾讯文档或本地Office文件后，可以选择原始文件中的文本、表格区域或PPT页面，并使用自然语言告诉AI需要完成什么任务。 例如，选择一份市场分析报告，优化其表达方式；圈出一组 Excel 数据，让 AI 对其进行分析并生成图表；指定一个PPT页面，让AI调整其结构和内容；在报告中标记空白区域，让 AI 添加相关部分。

AI生成的内容直接出现在原始文件中，用户可以在其中继续编辑或添加评论。 AI会实时感知并完成修改。 AI完成编辑后，用户可以随时接手继续写作。 这意味着AI不再只是“侧板助手”，而是成为创作过程中真正的协作者。

三大核心升级让AI从“辅助插件”转变为“第三同事”

此次升级的核心是赋予AI更多类似于真实协作者的文档操作能力和上下文感知能力，主要体现在三个方面：

首先，覆盖更多文件和场景，支持全人机共写。 依托腾讯文档的编辑能力，最新版本的WorkBuddy支持Markdown、Word、Excel、PPT等主流办公格式，覆盖本地Office文件和在线腾讯文档。 无论是论文、提案、教案、技术文档、咨询报告，还是运营周报、推介材料和数据分析，用户都可以在同一工作流程中完成创建、编辑和协作。

二是选修精准高效。 用户可以选择段落、数据区域或PPT画布，让AI仅在指定范围内进行更改，其余布局和内容保持不变。 例如，在 Excel 中，您可以圈出数千行数据，并让 AI 执行枢轴分析、生成趋势图表或批量纠正错误并应用复杂的公式。 切换到PPT，可以让AI自动将分析结论和图表布局在空白区域。 对于提案、教案等结构化文档，您可以选择需要填写的区域，让 AI 根据模板完成。

第三，多人加AI，实时协作不间断。 AI生成的内容可以一键上传到腾讯文档，让团队成员可以跨不同终端共同编辑同一份文档，并与同一个AI伙伴进行协作。 所有更改都是实时同步的，并且文档上下文保持不变。 从个人写作到团队协作，再到多人与人工智能一起完成同一任务，人类协作、人类与人工智能协作、人工智能与人工智能协作都无缝集成在同一个文档中。

从第一代解决个人本地办公，到第二代通过在线文档解决多人协作，随着AI代理深度融入企业生产力，办公软件正在走向第三阶段。 通过实现“人与人、人与人工智能、人工智能与人工智能”的协作，WorkBuddy 正在将 Office 从一个简单的工具转变为一个能够理解任务、理解上下文、协作编辑并持续管理业务运营的 AI 原生办公系统。

目前，WorkBuddy已成为国内DAU最受欢迎的效率AI工具之一，并实现了Win、Mac、HarmonyOS、Android等主流操作系统的全面覆盖。 在此基础上，WorkBuddy与腾讯文档、腾讯ima、腾讯会议、腾讯云盘、TAPD、腾讯乐享等生态产品深度融合，通过One ID全面打通内容创作、知识积累、能力复用链。
